name: expand-in-grid
description: A blue card with a darker pattern sits in a 2x2 grid of colourful tiles, then expands to the centre: scale 0.624->1 from its top edge (310 ms, material standard, 640 ms) while it moves right (translateX -188.5px->0, 258 ms, ease, 674 ms). A backdrop dims the tiles but not the card (opacity 0->0.78, 272 ms, ease, 650 ms). Models a persistent element whose colours fill most of the region at its expanded end.
